name: skill-authoring
title_zh: SKILL.md 写不对就装不上，这篇专治装不上的
tagline_zh: Claude Code 技能不加载、不自动唤起、放错目录？它教你从零写对 SKILL.md，装进插件市场。
tagline_en: Skills not loading, never auto-triggered, or in wrong folder? Learn to write and install SKILL.md correctly for.
desc_en: Write, debug, and install Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents that follow the Agent Skills spec. Use when a skill does not load, is never auto-invoked, lives in the wrong directory, or the user asks how to author SKILL.md, plugin marketplaces, or custom commands.
why_zh: 不是泛泛讲规范，而是按 Agent Skills 官方 spec 逐条核对，连目录位置。
why_en: Not generic advice—it walks the official Agent Skills spec line by line, covering directory placement and trigger conditions, so.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 SKILL.md 的编写、调试与安装，不教插件市场搭建或自定义命令的完整开发。
limit_en: Only covers authoring/debugging/installing SKILL.md, not full plugin marketplace or custom command dev; requires Claude Code and basic YAML.
title_en: Fix SKILL.md that won't load or auto-invoke
